en_title: Jensen Huang Reportedly Weighing Return as Nvidia CEO With Allies
cn_title: 据报道黄仁勋正与盟友商讨重返Nvidia担任首席执行官
opus_summary: 据《Financial Times》报道，Jensen Huang辞任Nvidia首席执行官数日后，与亲信私下讨论了复职的可能性。部分科技界人士呼吁他回归，Nvidia董事会则已接洽Arm首席执行官Rene Haas，考虑由其接任。

paragraphs.en: Jensen Huang has reportedly had discussions with his allies about a potential return as Nvidia's CEO just days after reports of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and multiple employees led to his resignation.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，黄仁勋已与盟友讨论了可能重返Nvidia担任首席执行官一事。就在几天前，有关他与一名据称是中国间谍的人以及多名员工存在婚外情的报道导致他辞职。

paragraphs.en: Information on what is only the latest unexpected turn in a tangled web of updates for the tech giant came from a new Financial Times report. It stated that Huang has had private discussions with confidantes about the possibility of his reinstatement, as some Nvidia employees and minds from across Silicon Valley call for his return.
paragraphs.cn: 这家科技巨头相关事态错综复杂，而有关其中最新一起意外转折的消息来自Financial Times的一篇新报道。报道称，黄仁勋已与亲信私下讨论了他复职的可能性，与此同时，一些Nvidia员工和硅谷各界人士正呼吁他回归。

paragraphs.en: Nvidia has found itself in headlines in the tech world for the wrong reasons the last week. The company's board announced it had launched an independent investigation into Huang just seven days ago as it looked into allegations that he had been unfaithful to his wife with an individual the U.S. government believed to be a spy working for the Chinese government. At the time, Nvidia said it "had no reason to believe that either national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised" but continued with the investigation to "examine all available information."
paragraphs.cn: 过去一周，Nvidia因负面原因登上了科技界的头条。就在七天前，公司董事会宣布已对黄仁勋展开独立调查，以调查有关他与一名美国政府认为是为中国政府工作的间谍有染、对妻子不忠的指控。当时，Nvidia表示「没有理由相信国家安全或Nvidia的机密受到了损害」，但仍继续调查，以「审查所有可获取的信息」。

paragraphs.en: It was a move that could rock any company, and it was just the start for Nvidia and Huang's week. The New York Times reported that the tech figurehead had an additional affair with company vice president of health care Kimberly Powell, who reported to him, just days later. Reuters launched its own report claiming he had another affair with a different employee that same day .
paragraphs.cn: 这一举动足以震动任何一家公司，而对Nvidia和黄仁勋来说，这只是一周的开始。几天后，纽约时报报道称，这位科技界领军人物还与公司医疗保健副总裁Kimberly Powell有染，后者直接向他汇报工作。同一天，路透社也发布报道称，他还与另一名员工有染。

paragraphs.en: Huang had announced his resignation as these reports emerged and as more rumors began to swirl, but the aftermath has only increased chatter online. Other giants in the tech space, including billionaire Elon Musk and Epic Games boss Tim Sweeney , have publicly called for his reinstatement. Now, Huang appears to be considering what that might look like himself.
paragraphs.cn: 随着这些报道出现、更多传闻开始流传，黄仁勋宣布辞职，但后续事态只让网上的议论更加热烈。科技界的其他巨头，包括亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克和Epic Games老板Tim Sweeney，都公开呼吁他复职。现在，黄仁勋本人似乎也在考虑复职可能会是什么样。

paragraphs.en: "Everyone that matters in tech outside the frontier labs loves Jensen," one of Huang's allies, who also said Silicon Valley leaders were assembling a "war room" for his return with hopes to gain White House support, explained. The likelihood of the initiative panning out is unclear but is said to have Huang's support.
paragraphs.cn: 黄仁勋的一名盟友解释道：「前沿实验室之外，科技界所有举足轻重的人都喜欢黄仁勋。」他还表示，硅谷领袖正在为黄仁勋回归组建一个「作战室」，希望获得白宫支持。这项行动成功的可能性尚不明确，但据说得到了黄仁勋的支持。

paragraphs.en: However, if they continue their plan to get Huang back as Nvidia CEO, it won't be easy. He resigned from the company just days ago, and although the details of any alleged affairs remain unclear, there's no denying the damage done to his public reputation. One ally pushing for him to come back acknowledged that "having an affair with a subordinate is a fireable offense."
paragraphs.cn: 然而，如果他们继续推行让黄仁勋重返Nvidia担任首席执行官的计划，事情不会容易。他几天前才从公司辞职，尽管有关任何被指婚外情的细节仍不清楚，但不可否认的是，他的公众声誉已经受损。一名推动他回归的盟友承认，「与下属有染是足以被解雇的过错」。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Nvidia is already actively working behind the scenes to find a replacement. Executive vice president and chief financial officer Colette Kress is currently serving as interim CEO in Huang's place. The Financial Times reported that the company's board had already approached Arm chief executive Rene Haas as a potential replacement.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，Nvidia已经在幕后积极寻找继任者。执行副总裁兼首席财务官Colette Kress目前正接替黄仁勋担任临时首席执行官。Financial Times报道称，公司董事会已经接洽Arm首席执行官Rene Haas，将他视为潜在继任者。

paragraphs.en: It's a rapidly developing and unprecedented situation with ramifications felt far outside the tech world. IGN examined what the changes might mean for GeForce going forward in the aftermath of Huang's resignation.
paragraphs.cn: 这一局面发展迅速且史无前例，其影响远远超出了科技界。黄仁勋辞职后，IGN探讨了这些变化可能对GeForce未来意味着什么。
